6.201 rsInvalidGroupingParent
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidGroupingParent is a critical error that will occur when a Grouping element contains a
Grouping.Parent element but more than one Grouping.GroupExpressions elements.
